[[Category:First level Basin Guardians]]
[[sn:Indus, God of the Indian Ocean]]Indus, God of the Indian Ocean - A wise and powerful god, ruling over the warm and vibrant waters of the Indian Ocean. He is associated with trade, commerce, and cultural exchange, and is revered as a bringer of prosperity and abundance. He is often depicted with a trident, symbolizing his dominion over the oceans.
